findings.current_text: {unit, select, now {ابھی} minute {{count, number, ::group-off} منٹ قبل} hour {{count, number, ::group-off} گھنٹے قبل} day {{count, number, ::group-off} دن قبل} week {{count, number, ::group-off} ہفتے قبل} year {{count, number, ::group-off} سال قبل} other {ابھی}}
findings.problem: The compact sidebar time repeats قبل (ago), expanding ordinary labels beyond the advisory 6-cell budget and unnecessarily consuming title space. A natural shorter form exists: numeral plus unit, with the full temporal sentence retained in the accessible label. No fixed six-cell clip is established: the sidecar expressly calls the width advisory and the time span uses shrink-0 rather than a fixed-width box.
findings.measurement_method: rich.cells.cell_len on IntlMessageFormat(ur) output; no bidi controls
findings.suggested_wording: Omit قبل from compact unit branches: e.g. 59 منٹ (6 cells), 6 دن (4), 1 سال (5). Prefer grammatically singular 1 گھنٹہ (7) / 1 ہفتہ (6) and plural forms when applicable. Natural 23 گھنٹے is 8 cells and 52 ہفتے is 7; document those narrow advisory exceptions instead of inventing obscure abbreviations. Keep relative_created/relative_active as full sentences.
findings.severity_reason: Nonblocking compactness improvement: native words are understandable; a shorter natural rendering exists. No rendered clipping/wrapping was measured, so MAJOR would be unsupported.
